rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 第３次小泉内閣の発足 states that on 21 September 2005 the cabinet resigned en masse at a morning extraordinary cabinet meeting, before the 163rd special session convened that afternoon designated 小泉純一郎 as the 89th Prime Minister.

locator.section: first paragraph under 平成１７年９月２１日

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same page states that after the designation and a press conference 小泉総理 was appointed at the Imperial appointment ceremony as the 89th Prime Minister (56th person) since Itō Hirobumi, then formed the third cabinet reappointing all ministers of the 2004 reshuffle.
